summary: Ansible can be slow on systems with slow disks such as a Raspberry Pi; installing libyaml support can help.
questions: Ansible is very slow on my Raspberry Pi, how do I speed it up?

answer_card.title: Speed up Ansible on slow disks
answer_card.answer_md: On slow-disk systems (e.g. Raspberry Pi), make sure PyYAML uses the **libyaml** C bindings. Without them YAML parsing is much slower. Check with `ansible --version` (it reports libyaml) and reinstall PyYAML with libyaml available.
